channel.title: The Batch | DeepLearning.AI
channel.description: Weekly AI news for engineers, executives, and enthusiasts.

item.title: Anthropic releases new top models: Meta’s Muse Ember rivals leading fast models
item.description: AlphaProof Code verifies Signal’s cryptography algorithm. Alibaba’s Co-Design Bench measures fully correct commits. Google’s most powerful model now available for developers. Anthropic ports Claude from Nvidia to AMD processors in three days.

item.title: All the fallout so far from Nvidia CEO’s affair: Inkling 2 Small jumps 18 points on Intelligence Index
item.description: GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5 percent on ExploitGym. Decision Index v2 weighs decision models’ accuracy, cost. Pangram releases its first AI image, video detectors. Nous reveals open Alibaba models’ shallow political alignment.

item.title: Context Engineering for Images: MIT researchers build VISTA, an agent harness that keeps images in memory for faster retrieval
item.description: Managing an agent’s context by storing all the input text it receives and giving it tools to search the text boosts its performance.

item.title: World Models Become Robot Playgrounds: Google Genie 4 combines with Gemini models to build better video game worlds, robotics training
item.description: Google says that Genie 4, its latest world model, will be used in tandem with Gemini models to create digital practice spaces for robots, giving them endless worlds to train in

item.title: Anthropic Opens Its Books: Anthropic's S-1 outlines company's strong financials, methods, potential risks after IPO
item.description: Claude’s maker will sell company shares to the public for the first time.

item.title: Gemini Leads the Pack Again: Google Gemini 4 Carbon tops Intelligence Index, cybersecurity benchmarks
item.description: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon puts the company on top of Artificial Analysis’ Intelligence Index, edging past Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, while costing less per task.

item.title: AI Job Anxieties Meet AI Job Opporunities: A LinkedIn Pulse Study Shows AI Job Creation, Growth, Careers
item.description: LinkedIn data shows that AI has helped create 2 million jobs.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Heads Toward Wider Availability, What Anthropic's IPO Means for Developers, Genie 4 Combines with Gemini to Train Robots
item.description: The Batch News & Insights: LinkedIn data shows that AI has helped create 2 million jobs.

item.title: AI models can read other models’ weights: FlashProve easily verifies a model’s claimed outputs
item.description: Microsoft plugin reduces costs of repeated inputs. Google criticized for linking students’ search access to Gemini. OpenAI, Anthropic, others fight election misinformation. U.S. voters want more checks on data center construction.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon leads the Intelligence Index: Grok Bot gets throttled after unsustainable demand
item.description: robots.txt rules to block AI crawlers get simpler. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe claims high marks on translation. EmbeddingGemma 2 is the best free multimodal option. Spotify explores fan-created AI remixes.

item.title: Leaders Lock Models Away: Could companies or governments shut down frontier AI development?
item.description: Fearful of their own discoveries, AI engineers at top companies warn that frontier models have improved too quickly to be properly guided, understood, or restrained.

item.title: AI Detectors Find the Devil’s Work: Writers, students, engineers face false accusations of using AI
item.description: Last month, the Haiti-born, Quebec-based author Thélyson Orélien won a prestigious literary prize for C’était ça ou mourir (It Was Either That or Die), his French-language novel about a teacher forced to flee Haiti’s gang violence.

item.title: AI Bites the Hand That Feeds It: Scientists, other users fear AI companies will train on or misuse sensitive data
item.description: Developers, scientists, and businesses feed AI tools their private code, unpublished research, and confidential files.

item.title: Dawn of the Agents: Will AI agents self-organize or lose control due to bad safety practices?
item.description: This year, AI agents escaped containment at several labs, conspired with each other online, and infiltrated other organizations’ systems.

item.title: How to Face Your AI Fears This Year: Introduction to a special Halloween 2026 edition of The Batch
item.description: Following our annual tradition, this special Halloween edition of The Batch treats leading AI fears.
